capabilities: keep folded blocks collapsed when pressing Enter
insert an empty sibling block after the folded section
preserve heading level, indentation, marker and numbering of the source block
respect folds created by any means via CodeMirror fold state
decline and leave Enter to Obsidian when conditions are not met
disambiguation: Not an auto-folding plugin; it never folds anything itself and only preserves folds you already made when you press Enter.
extras: Not in the community plugin store; must be installed manually from GitHub releases into the plugins folder.
intentEvidence: Stay Folded reads CodeMirror's fold state, so it respects every fold no matter what created it
problem: Pressing Enter on a folded heading or list item in Obsidian expands the section and puts the new line inside it, destroying the fold the user set up.
summary: Enter-key handler that keeps folded headings and list items collapsed, inserting an empty sibling block after the folded section instead of expanding it.
